core_thesis: Orzhov is white-black power expressed as obligation: social order, spiritual authority, and personal ambition fused into contracts that outlive the body.

primary_axes.definition: Every action creates obligation; every obligation can become control.
Death is not freedom; it is a second phase of service, haunting, or collection.
Rank, title, office, and wealth determine personhood and permission.
Confession, sin, penance, and absolution are spiritual tools used to extract leverage.
Life is an account balance; their loss and your gain are paired transactions.
Expendable bodies are converted into cards, mana, protection, spirit labor, or tablewide drain.

archetypal_roles.description: Turns wording, procedure, and technicality into power.
Speaks sacred authority that blesses insiders and diminishes outsiders.
Extracts repeated small payments until the table is exhausted.
Uses wealth and undeath to preserve authority beyond accountability.
Makes the contract physical when soft power fails.
Continues service after death as a token, haunting, or recurring asset.

mechanical_taxonomy.haunt: Past action attaches to future death, making consequence linger beyond the first body.
mechanical_taxonomy.extort: Every spell becomes a tithe event: small payments compound into inevitability.
mechanical_taxonomy.afterlife: Death produces spirit labor; the board keeps an echo of the original asset.
mechanical_taxonomy.lifegain_drain: White preservation and black extraction become a single accounting loop.
mechanical_taxonomy.aristocrats: Sacrifice is not waste; it is conversion of low-status assets into high-status advantage.
mechanical_taxonomy.tax_prison: Players retain agency but must pay through tempo, life, mana, or opportunity cost.
mechanical_taxonomy.recursion: The graveyard is an estate registry where useful assets can be reclaimed.

voice_guidelines.sentence_shape: Elegant sentence, then a knife of transaction: “The blessing is real; so is the invoice.”

placement_read_template.opening: You do not see power as chaos; you see it as obligation with architecture.
placement_read_template.middle: Where others see death, guilt, status, and payment as separate forces, Orzhov turns them into one durable machine.
placement_read_template.closing: Your magic does not merely win the moment. It makes the moment owe you interest.
